title: India turns net overweight market for Asia-Pacific fund managers
summary: India has recently become a net overweight market for fund managers in Asia-Pacific, indicating reduced interest in North Asian equities. title: FPIs pump record Rs 84,291 crore into Indian stocks in first half of November
summary: In the first half of November, foreign portfolio investors significantly increased their investment in Indian equities.
